<!-- pr-reviewer: 5f4316003aee8e74fb48e29a86c6071d22ee5f86 -->

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good
- One source for the skill text: a hand-written body (`cli_skill.md`) plus the CLI's own help texts, so the command reference cannot drift. The drift test (`skill_text_names_every_cli_lane_and_no_other`) pins it.
- An existing file is never replaced without `--force`; the refusal names the path and the way out, writes nothing, and does not touch the user's own `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
- Each target is a thin wrapper around one text. `folder` needs `--dir`; `claude` writes the project skill by default, the home skill with `--user`; `copilot` writes a `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md` file with `applyTo: "**"`.
- Tests join the existing top-level `cli` suite; no new test binary; `cli.rs` stays under 400 lines (393); no new dependency; no process files; no snapshot PNGs; no golden changes; no build.rs or `.github` or `scripts` or `.cargo` changes.

Results merged with main (self-hosted runner, [pr-test run 45629106357](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/45629106357), trial merge clean, main baad348f191a5f2261dc778ac3f9853aaf19ffa0)
- Quick gate (merged tree): 10 steps, 0 failed - app build, app suites: lib, ai_guide, cli, default_machine_missing, example_catalog, first_part_programs, mcp, mcp_verify, regression_models
- Clippy (`camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`): clean

Targeted tests (local, release)
- Light lane: 6 steps, 0 failed - motion light: lib, adaptive_troch_island, adaptive_troch_neck, adaptive_troch_parallel, app light: pocket_pass_start
- Example catalog: not applicable - the diff touches no post or toolpath
- Targeted heavy step: not applicable - this is P2, not safety-floor P1, and no toolpath, post or geometry code changed

Requested before merge
None.

Questions / notes (non-blocking)
1. `--force` writes through a symlink. `cli_skill.rs:179` calls `std::fs::write(&path, ...)`, which follows a symlink at the skill path, so a link to a file outside the skill folder is overwritten with the skill text. The no-force path is safe: `cli_skill.rs:170` refuses a symlinked target and writes nothing. Consider removing the link and writing a fresh file instead of following it (or refusing it with the same message).
2. The lane writes no MCP tool. That matches the decision doc (the lane writes a text file; it changes no document state and has no undo; `camcraft-cli mcp reference` still serves the tool table). No follow-up issue filed, and the body says so - fine as written.
3. Note on the light lane: the author's note ("no light twin covers this change") is honest, and the lane was run anyway in release. All 11 light twins pass.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
